## Already built, CONFLICTS with blueprint

C1. [resolved 2026-08-10] **Export engine.** Code: self-contained Swift Markdown→HTML
    converter + WKWebView print/PDF. Blueprint: embedded Typst via Rust FFI (A1).
    → RESOLVED: keep the HTML pipeline. A1 marked [rejected] in DECISIONS.md.

C2. [resolved 2026-08-10] **Document identity.** Code: file paths as IDs
    (FileItem.id = url.path). Blueprint: stable UUIDs for documents and
    addressable blocks; wiki-links resolve via index, never by filename (A4).
    → RESOLVED: add the UUID overlay. A4 marked [locked] in DECISIONS.md.
    Path-based operations are unchanged.

C3. [resolved 2026-08-10] **Preview pipeline.** Code: WKWebView loads HTML, updates
    in-place via JS. Blueprint: live paginated Typst preview.
    → RESOLVED as a consequence of C1: no Typst, so the WKWebView preview stands.
    The blueprint's "what you see is the issued page" property is NOT delivered.

C4. [resolved 2026-08-10] **Syntax highlighting.** Code: regex-based on NSTextStorage
    (MarkdownHighlighter). Blueprint: AST-based via cmark/swift-markdown, serving
    as input to the unified rules engine (A5).
    → RESOLVED: add the AST as a second layer, for diagnostics only. A5 marked
    [locked]. The regex highlighter is untouched and keeps serving editor styling.
    NOTE: the swift-markdown dependency this needs is still RED and unauthorised.

C5. **Integrated terminal (macOS).** Code: vendored SwiftTerm, login zsh PTY.
    Blueprint: does not mention a terminal.
    → This is extra functionality code has that the blueprint doesn't address.
    No conflict — keep unless it becomes a maintenance burden.

C6. **Export formats.** Code: HTML, PDF (via WKWebView print), rich text copy.
    Blueprint: PDF, Markdown, HTML, DOCX, per-channel social text (§5).
    → DOCX and channel-based export are not built. Not a conflict — additional
    output formats are additions to the existing pipeline (or moot if Typst wins).

C7. **To-do persistence.** Code: UserDefaults, keyed by file path. Blueprint:
    shared state in JSONL append logs (A3).
    → UserDefaults breaks on rename (though code migrates todos on rename/move).
    JSONL logs would survive device loss and sync. Decision: keep UD for now;
    migrate when A3 store exists.
